list.retiredBody_other: {{ids}} are recorded as installed but were removed from Tilecast. They no longer run, and their data is kept.

shared.manageNote: Owner or Administrator access is required to make changes.

history.subtitle: Measurements the player recorded locally and delivered on its ordinary heartbeat.
history.privacyNotice: Noise history stores relative noise-level measurements for graphs and reports. Tilecast never records or stores microphone audio. Levels are relative to each player's own microphone and are not calibrated decibel measurements.
history.screenHint: Levels are relative to each player's own microphone, so screens are compared with care.
history.exportTitle: Export the selected range and screen
history.combining: Combining {{count}} screens. Each player's levels come from its own microphone, so a combined view describes the group rather than comparing rooms.
history.emptyDescription: History appears once a targeted Linux player has been measuring and has delivered a heartbeat.
history.chartDescription: Average and peak, against this meter's own thresholds. Periods with no monitoring are left blank.

chart.aria: Noise Level over time. Warning level {{warning}}, too loud level {{loud}}.
chart.description: Average and peak Noise Level are shown over time. Gaps indicate periods with no monitoring. The warning threshold is {{warning}}; the too-loud threshold is {{loud}}.

history.dailyDescription: Days without monitoring are omitted rather than shown as silent.
